title: A scrolling graph
description:
Keep the last 300 samples of a value and its range for a live graph.

```
samples: 300, newest 61.2
min 12.0, max 98.4, average 55.1
graph scale: 0 to 100 (rounded out to tens)
```
hints: `std::isnan(v)` checks for NaN; skip it before storing.
requirements: A ring buffer of 300 floats, as in the frame times project.
The graph's scale is the minimum and maximum rounded down and up to the nearest 10.
stretch: Keep a second series and draw both on the same scale.
